data.name: Protean Rings: Time to Live
data.detailed_description:
Protean Rings is a top down squad stealth strategy heist sandbox. Command specialists to infiltrate with disguises and intel. Run solo/synced plays to bend guards, civilians, and systems into an opening to rescue, kidnap, kill, or embarrass a target—or steal, sabotage, or plant it. Extract cleanly.

Command multiple professional operatives, study patrol patterns, gather intel, and position your team before you commit.

Choose how to break through enemy defenses using each operative’s unique abilities and tools to create distractions, isolate enemies, coordinate actions, manipulate environmental opportunities, and open a path to the objective.

Improvise and recover when plans go wrong.

Missions are designed around multiple valid solutions and replayability. You can stay quiet and methodical, split your team to solve problems from different angles, or take a louder approach and deal with the consequences as guards investigate, search, and escalate.

Complete the objective, adapt under pressure, and extract your team safely.

Features

  • Team-based tactical stealth gameplay

  • Objective-driven infiltration and extraction

  • Replayable open ended sandbox scenarios with multiple solution paths that reward mastery and experimentation

  • Control a team of operatives with distinct roles, tools, and coordinated abilities

  • Scout enemy positions, track patrols, and plan your route before you strike

  • Use stealth, distractions, deception, and positioning to create openings

  • Manage noise, line of sight, and escalating enemy alert states as the mission reacts to your actions

  • Extract the objective and bring your entire team home
